data.title: Stock Market Today: Indexes Open Higher After Losing Day for S&P 500, Nasdaq; Oil Prices Drop; Bitcoin Briefly Tops $80K
data.description: Major U.S. stock indexes opened higher Tuesday, a day after the Nasdaq Composite and S&P 500 began the week with losses, as oil prices retreated and bitcoin briefly topped $80,000 for the first time in more than three months.
